summary: Chor Ratchawat is a Muay Thai camp with two gyms in Bo Phut and Plai Laem, Koh Samui, offering group, private, kids and fighter programs plus DTV document help.

facts.label: DTV
facts.value: Helps with documents for the DTV visa
facts.quote: We help you get the documents for the Thailand DTV visa, up to 180 days.

facts.label: Group sessions
facts.quote: Morning and afternoon sessions with pad work, bag work, clinching, and conditioning.

facts.label: Opening hours
facts.quote: Open 6 days a week from 7 AM to 8 PM.

facts.label: Locations
facts.value: Two camps, Bo Phut and Plai Laem
facts.quote: two locations in Bo Phut and Plai Laem
